description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the great mine at its grandest: a fortified mine entrance in a blue-grey rocky hill with a hewn stone portal and an iron-barred gate, a tall timber headframe with a big iron wheel above it, rails coming out with three carts full of red iron ore, iron lanterns and a heap of ore

references.usage: the previous, third stage of this same building in the camp, chosen by the author: keep its idea, colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw its fourth, grandest stage, rebuilt for the stronghold with grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron
